line: Namaskara Bengaluru! Manju here... traffic update, quick one.
notes: Radio RJ, warm and quick, smiling. Bright opener; small breath before 'traffic update'.
english: Hello, Bengaluru! Manju here... traffic update, quick one.

line: Hello hello hello. RJ Manju. Ond nimisha, traffic nodona.
notes: Radio RJ, warm and quick, smiling. Playful triple hello, then casual.
english: Hello hello hello. RJ Manju. One minute, let's look at the traffic.

line: Aaand we're back. Manju here. Roads hegide? Let's see.
notes: Radio RJ, warm and quick, smiling. Stretch 'Aaand'; 'Roads hegide?' as a real question.
english: And we're back. Manju here. How are the roads? Let's see.

line: Uff. Peak hour, guru. Outer Ring Road... full jam. Bumper to bumper.
notes: Radio RJ, warm and quick, smiling. Tired sigh on 'Uff'. Pause after 'Outer Ring Road'.
english: Uff. Peak hour, my friend. Outer Ring Road... full jam. Bumper to bumper.

line: Office time. Everybody is on the road, nobody is moving. Adjust maadi.
notes: Radio RJ, warm and quick, smiling. Dry, amused.
english: Office time. Everybody is on the road, nobody is moving. Please adjust.

line: Signal alli full line ide. Patience, patience. Horn beda, please.
notes: Radio RJ, warm and quick, smiling. Gentle scolding on 'Horn beda'.
english: There's a long line at the signal. Patience, patience. No honking, please.

line: Roads are free right now. Sakkath time to ride.
notes: Radio RJ, warm and quick, smiling. Upbeat.
english: Roads are free right now. A great time to ride.

line: No jam, no tension. Arre, is this even Bengaluru?
notes: Radio RJ, warm and quick, smiling. Mock surprise on the question.

line: Traffic is okay-okay. Swalpa slow near the signals, ashte.
notes: Radio RJ, warm and quick, smiling. Shrugging, matter of fact.
english: Traffic is okay. A little slow near the signals, that's all.

line: Late aagide. Roads are khaali... only the street dogs are on duty.
notes: Radio RJ, warm and quick, smiling. Softer, late-night voice; smile on the dogs.
english: It's late. Roads are empty... only the street dogs are on duty.

line: Empty roads, but signal jump maadbedi. Police mama is still awake.
notes: Radio RJ, warm and quick, smiling. Low, teasing warning.
english: Empty roads, but don't jump the signal. The policeman is still awake.

line: Male bartha ide! Roads are slippery, brake slowly, okay?
notes: Radio RJ, warm and quick, smiling. Excited on 'Male bartha ide', then caring.
english: It's raining! Roads are slippery, brake slowly, okay?

line: Rain, guru. Potholes are swimming pools now. Nodkondu hogi.
notes: Radio RJ, warm and quick, smiling. Wry.
english: Rain, my friend. Potholes are swimming pools now. Watch where you're going.

line: One bus has broken down, one lane is blocked. Swalpa adjust maadi.
notes: Radio RJ, warm and quick, smiling. News voice, then friendly. No road name: the screen shows it.
english: One bus has broken down, one lane is blocked. Please adjust a little.

line: Road dug up again... pipe work, as usual. Bere route thogoli.
notes: Radio RJ, warm and quick, smiling. Weary 'as usual'.
english: Road dug up again... pipe work, as usual. Take another route.

line: Wedding procession on the road, band and all. Slow hogi... and wish the couple!
notes: Radio RJ, warm and quick, smiling. Happy; respectful about the wedding.
english: Wedding procession on the road, band and all. Go slowly... and wish the couple!

line: One bull is standing in the middle of the road. Full relaxed. Horn maadbedi, just go around.
notes: Radio RJ, warm and quick, smiling. Fond, unhurried.
english: One bull is standing in the middle of the road. Fully relaxed. Don't honk, just go around.

line: Helmet haakoli, signal follow maadi. Back to the music.
notes: Radio RJ, warm and quick, smiling. Sign-off, falling tone.
english: Wear your helmet, follow the signals. Back to the music.

line: Ashte from me. Ride safe, Bengaluru.
notes: Radio RJ, warm and quick, smiling. Warm.
english: That's all from me. Ride safe, Bengaluru.

line: Okay, bye bye. More music, less horn.
notes: Radio RJ, warm and quick, smiling. Light, quick.

line: Vehicle beka? GaadiGo! Scooter, cycle, even a van... on rent, by the hour. GaadiGo: neevu ride maadi, tension namge.
notes: Radio ad read by the RJ: faster, sales voice, slogan slower. Every brand is made up.
english: Need a vehicle? GaadiGo! Scooter, cycle, even a van... on rent, by the hour. GaadiGo: you ride, the tension is ours.

line: Minchu E-One. Electric scooter. Goes like lightning, drinks nothing. Minchu: current alli future.
notes: Radio ad read by the RJ: faster, sales voice, slogan slower. Every brand is made up.
english: Minchu E-One. Electric scooter. Goes like lightning, drinks nothing. Minchu: the future is electric.

line: Swarna Mahal Jewellers. This wedding season, making charges... fifty percent off. Namma mane, namma chinna.
notes: Radio ad read by the RJ: faster, sales voice, slogan slower. Every brand is made up. Rich, slower.
english: Swarna Mahal Jewellers. This wedding season, making charges... fifty percent off. Our home, our gold.

line: Hungry at midnight? Crispy Coop, open till two. Ondu bite, full delight.
notes: Radio ad read by the RJ: faster, sales voice, slogan slower. Every brand is made up.
english: Hungry at midnight? Crispy Coop, open till two. One bite, full delight.

line: Filter House coffee. Slow decoction, steel tumbler, bisi bisi. Kaapi first, everything next.
notes: Radio ad read by the RJ: faster, sales voice, slogan slower. Every brand is made up. Cosy.
english: Filter House coffee. Slow decoction, steel tumbler, piping hot. Coffee first, everything next.

line: Sampige Residency. Two and three BHK. Five minutes from everywhere... according to our brochure.
notes: Radio ad read by the RJ: faster, sales voice, slogan slower. Every brand is made up. Deadpan on the last part.

line: Stride Shoe Company. Buy two pairs, third pair for ajji, free. Hejje hejje comfort.
notes: Radio ad read by the RJ: faster, sales voice, slogan slower. Every brand is made up.
english: Stride Shoe Company. Buy two pairs, third pair for grandma, free. Comfort in every step.

line: Riders beku! Join Deliver It. Weekly payout, flexible hours, yellow jacket. Bega, jopana, on time.
notes: Radio ad read by the RJ: faster, sales voice, slogan slower. Every brand is made up.
english: Riders wanted! Join Deliver It. Weekly payout, flexible hours, yellow jacket. Fast, careful, on time.

line: Haan maga, you're online. Orders coming.
notes: On the phone, friendly dispatcher, late 30s, Bengaluru Kannada-English. Relaxed.
english: Yes, buddy, you're online. Orders coming.

line: Good, good. Online aagidya. Jopana, okay?
notes: On the phone, friendly dispatcher, late 30s, Bengaluru Kannada-English.
english: Good, good. You're online. Be careful, okay?

line: Ey, one order bandide. Nodu.
notes: On the phone, friendly dispatcher, late 30s, Bengaluru Kannada-English. Quick, mid-task.
english: Hey, an order has come in. Take a look.

line: New order, maga. Take it or leave it, your wish.
notes: On the phone, friendly dispatcher, late 30s, Bengaluru Kannada-English.
english: New order, buddy. Take it or leave it, your wish.

line: Order ide. Hattira, near only.
notes: On the phone, friendly dispatcher, late 30s, Bengaluru Kannada-English.
english: There's an order. It's close by.

line: Picked up? Sari. Hogu, hogu.
notes: On the phone, friendly dispatcher, late 30s, Bengaluru Kannada-English. Hurrying him along.
english: Picked up? Okay. Go, go.

line: Bag sikta? Bega hogu... but jopana.
notes: On the phone, friendly dispatcher, late 30s, Bengaluru Kannada-English. Pause before 'but jopana'.
english: Got the bag? Go quickly... but carefully.

line: Five star! Sakkath, maga.
notes: On the phone, friendly dispatcher, late 30s, Bengaluru Kannada-English. Proud.
english: Five stars! Superb, buddy.

line: Olle kelsa. Customer is happy.
notes: On the phone, friendly dispatcher, late 30s, Bengaluru Kannada-English.
english: Good work. Customer is happy.

line: Done. Okay okay. Next one.
notes: On the phone, friendly dispatcher, late 30s, Bengaluru Kannada-English. Neutral.

line: Ayyo. Customer complained, guru. Swalpa careful.
notes: On the phone, friendly dispatcher, late 30s, Bengaluru Kannada-English. Disappointed, not angry.
english: Oh no. The customer complained, my friend. Be a little careful.

line: Ey! Yen aaythu? You okay?
notes: On the phone, friendly dispatcher, late 30s, Bengaluru Kannada-English. Worried.
english: Hey! What happened? You okay?

line: Ayyo, jopana maga! Order nodu, is it fine?
notes: On the phone, friendly dispatcher, late 30s, Bengaluru Kannada-English.
english: Oh no, careful, buddy! Check the order, is it fine?

line: Gaadi kettoytha? Call the mechanic... or take a GaadiGo.
notes: On the phone, friendly dispatcher, late 30s, Bengaluru Kannada-English. Practical.
english: Has the vehicle broken down? Call the mechanic... or take a GaadiGo.

line: Sari, rest maadu. Naale sigona.
notes: On the phone, friendly dispatcher, late 30s, Bengaluru Kannada-English. Kind.
english: Okay, get some rest. See you tomorrow.

line: Okay maga, offline. Oota maadu.
notes: On the phone, friendly dispatcher, late 30s, Bengaluru Kannada-English.
english: Okay buddy, offline. Go and eat.

line: Coming, coming! Ond nimisha.
notes: Record with two voices (a: woman, b: man), files <id>.a.ogg and <id>.b.ogg. Through a door or from a balcony, ordinary and unhurried. Calling out from inside.
english: Coming, coming! One minute.

line: Haan, bandhe! One second.
notes: Record with two voices (a: woman, b: man), files <id>.a.ogg and <id>.b.ogg. Through a door or from a balcony, ordinary and unhurried.
english: Yes, I'm coming! One second.

line: Yes yes, coming.
notes: Record with two voices (a: woman, b: man), files <id>.a.ogg and <id>.b.ogg. Through a door or from a balcony, ordinary and unhurried.

line: Bruno! Quiet! ...Sorry, he only barks. Coming!
notes: Record with two voices (a: woman, b: man), files <id>.a.ogg and <id>.b.ogg. Through a door or from a balcony, ordinary and unhurried. First two words to the dog, sharp; then apologetic.

line: Tiger, inside! Inside! One minute, I'm tying him.
notes: Record with two voices (a: woman, b: man), files <id>.a.ogg and <id>.b.ogg. Through a door or from a balcony, ordinary and unhurried.

line: I'm on a call... please keep it outside the door. Thanks!
notes: Record with two voices (a: woman, b: man), files <id>.a.ogg and <id>.b.ogg. Through a door or from a balcony, ordinary and unhurried. Half-whispered.

line: Baby is sleeping, bell beda! Just leave it at the door.
notes: Record with two voices (a: woman, b: man), files <id>.a.ogg and <id>.b.ogg. Through a door or from a balcony, ordinary and unhurried. Hushed, urgent.
english: Baby is sleeping, don't ring the bell! Just leave it at the door.

line: Hands are full in the kitchen. Keep it outside na.
notes: Record with two voices (a: woman, b: man), files <id>.a.ogg and <id>.b.ogg. Through a door or from a balcony, ordinary and unhurried.

line: Coming down! Stay there only.
notes: Record with two voices (a: woman, b: man), files <id>.a.ogg and <id>.b.ogg. Through a door or from a balcony, ordinary and unhurried. Calling from a balcony.

line: One second, I'm coming to the gate.
notes: Record with two voices (a: woman, b: man), files <id>.a.ogg and <id>.b.ogg. Through a door or from a balcony, ordinary and unhurried.

line: Thank you, anna!
notes: Record with two voices (a: woman, b: man), files <id>.a.ogg and <id>.b.ogg. Through a door or from a balcony, ordinary and unhurried. Warm.
english: Thank you, brother!

line: Super, thanks. Bye!
notes: Record with two voices (a: woman, b: man), files <id>.a.ogg and <id>.b.ogg. Through a door or from a balcony, ordinary and unhurried.

line: Aah, finally. Thank you.
notes: Record with two voices (a: woman, b: man), files <id>.a.ogg and <id>.b.ogg. Through a door or from a balcony, ordinary and unhurried. Relieved, a little hungry.

line: Wait, wait! Trying it on. One minute!
notes: Record with two voices (a: woman, b: man), files <id>.a.ogg and <id>.b.ogg. Through a door or from a balcony, ordinary and unhurried.

line: Hold on, let me check the size.
notes: Record with two voices (a: woman, b: man), files <id>.a.ogg and <id>.b.ogg. Through a door or from a balcony, ordinary and unhurried.

line: Perfect fit! Keeping it.
notes: Record with two voices (a: woman, b: man), files <id>.a.ogg and <id>.b.ogg. Through a door or from a balcony, ordinary and unhurried. Pleased.

line: Sorry, lift is not working since morning. Stairs only.
notes: Record with two voices (a: woman, b: man), files <id>.a.ogg and <id>.b.ogg. Through a door or from a balcony, ordinary and unhurried. Apologetic.

line: Hello! Delivery? Gate ge banni first.
notes: Apartment security guard at a gate, 50s, polite and routine. Calling across.
english: Hello! Delivery? Come to the gate first.

line: Delivery? OTP heli.
notes: Apartment security guard at a gate, 50s, polite and routine.
english: Delivery? Tell me the OTP.

line: Sari, it matches. Register alli sign maadi.
notes: Apartment security guard at a gate, 50s, polite and routine.
english: Okay, it matches. Sign in the register.

line: Okay, hogi. Vehicle stays outside the gate.
notes: Apartment security guard at a gate, 50s, polite and routine.
english: Okay, go ahead. Vehicle stays outside the gate.

line: Order ready. Jopana, maga!
notes: Dark store counter staff, young, busy.
english: Order ready. Careful, buddy!

line: Tagoli. Bega hogi.
notes: Dark store counter staff, young, busy.
english: Take it. Go quickly.
